summary: This topic explains how to configure the automatic generation of unique receipt numbers for all admission-related financial transactions within the ERP system.
steps: Set a 'Prefix' for the receipt numbers (e.g., 'SDI' for SDI University).
Set the 'Starting Number' for the receipt counter (e.g., '1').
The system will automatically generate subsequent receipt numbers by incrementing the counter after the prefix (e.g., SDI-001, SDI-002, SDI-003).
important_notes: The receipt number prefix can be provided by the client or determined by the implementer.
The receipt counter updates automatically with each new transaction.
questions: How do I set up automatic receipt numbering for admission transactions?
Where can I configure the prefix for transaction receipts?
How does the system generate unique receipt numbers for payments?
